text_block_list.text:
Today is the Spring Fan Appreciation Festival! As many
Umamusume take part in events to entertain their fans,
Eishin Flash is no exception—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Hmph...!

text_block_list.name: Event MC
text_block_list.text: —Eishin Flash crosses the finish line in first place!

text_block_list.name: Event MC
text_block_list.text: "The winner of the Ping-Pong Ball Race, with pinpoint footwork that didn't drop the ball even once, is Eishin Flash!"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: (Clap clap clap clap...!)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Thank you all for your cheers.

text_block_list.name: Flash Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, Lady Flash...
I'd love to talk to her just once...

text_block_list.name: Flash Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"...Just kidding. Watching from
a distance is more than enough for me...
Just look at that gorgeously radiant hair."

text_block_list.name: Flash Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"She's so divine, there's no way I could
look at her from up close... Haa, how wonderful..."

...It seems many of Eishin Flash's fans
are quiet and reserved, much like her.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Trainer, that concludes all the events I was registered for.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"As for what comes next, the events wrapped up earlier
than scheduled, so we actually have some free time."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: If Trainer doesn't have any specific preference, I was thinking of looking for an event we could join on short notice.

Hearing those words, I suddenly remember the fans watching
her from a distance. If only there were a place where they
could interact, even if forced a little—

text_block_list.name: Event MC
text_block_list.text:
“—And so it begins! The wildly popular
fan-participation event, the ‘Fan Carrying Race’!”

text_block_list.name: Event MC
text_block_list.text:
The rules are simple! A fan will step forward,
and the first Umamusume to cross the finish line
together with that fan wins!

text_block_list.name: Event MC
text_block_list.text: The participants in Block G are Gold Ship, Nakayama Festa, and Eishin Flash!

text_block_list.name: Event MC
text_block_list.text:
Now, which pair will be the first
to dive in?!
Fans, we'll need your cooperation!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
—Hraaah! I choose you!
Golshi-chan's destined...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
R-i-c-e b-a-l-l☆
And captured!

text_block_list.name: Golshi Fan
text_block_list.text:
WAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!?
A-A rice-bale carry~~~~!? It's high, it's scary, it's rough!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Mm, you there. You've got a look on your face like your luck's turning around... Come with me.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What? Ah, whoa, whoa...!
W-With one hand, so effortlessly...! Amazing...!

text_block_list.name: Flash Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, oh no!
Lady Flash is going to lose!

text_block_list.name: Flash Fan A
text_block_list.text: Still, someone like me could never...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Um, excuse me. That flag...
It's in the colors of my racing silks, isn't it?
"The moment she heard that reply—Eishin Flash took the fan's hand."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"We are running out of time. Would you please
lend me your strength?"

text_block_list.name: Flash Fan A
text_block_list.text:
...!!
Of course!!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
Excuse me, then.

text_block_list.name: Flash Fan A
text_block_list.text:
...!!
A-A-A-A bridal carry...?!

text_block_list.name: Event MC
text_block_list.text:
――And taking Block G is Gold Ship!
With a blistering run that blows the fans' very souls away,
she forcefully seizes victoryyyy!

text_block_list.name: Flash Fan A
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry... It's because I didn't step forward right away...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"No, beating her in a competition like this
was utterly impossible from the start."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
“—I could never
neglect the fans who mean so much to me...”

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: How are you feeling? Everything okay?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Huh? Uh, um... thank you. Er, how are you feeling...?

Though she lost the event, the bond between
Eishin Flash and her fans grew stronger.

text_block_list.name: Event MC
text_block_list.text:
“—And the winner is Eishin Flash!
Despite a significantly delayed start,
she seized victory with an astounding late burst!”

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Because you held onto me tightly,
I was able to run steadily.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Flash Fan A
text_block_list.text:
N-No, the pleasure was all mine...!
It was such... such an honor...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! ...She left.
I wanted to talk a little more, though.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Hm? And you are...?

text_block_list.name: Flash Fan C
text_block_list.text: We're huge fans of yours, Miss Flash...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Lord...?

text_block_list.name: Flash Fan D
text_block_list.text:
Watching the match earlier gave me courage!
Um, we won't ask for a hug or anything...!
Can we do something together too!?

text_block_list.name: Flash Fans
text_block_list.text:
Please!
Lady Flash...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.
choice_data_list: I'll go check if we can hold a talk session!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...!
Thank you very much.
And so, Eishin Flash was able to deepen her bond with her fans.
